title: Training Calculator
description: Total level, promotion, skill, mastery and module costs across your targets, then compare them with your current inventory.
chooseDescription: Add targets from your current roster or the full operator list.
noBox: No operator roster is available. You can still choose from all operators.
noTargets: Add an operator to see current and target levels alongside the resource cost.
costSourceNote: Current skill and module levels come from Skland. Without Skland data, they are treated as untrained; adjust the targets here.
inventoryReady: Inventory loaded. Edit quantities to use different amounts in this plan.
inventoryUnavailable: Could not read Skland inventory. Enter quantities manually.
inventorySaved: Inventory amounts are saved in this browser separately for each account and role.
inventorySaveFailed: Could not save inventory changes in this browser.
noMaterialShortages: Your inventory covers the material cost for these targets.
dailyEstimateNote: Enter the LMD and EXP you can put toward training each day to estimate how long the money and records shortage will take.
sourceNote: Costs and crafting recipes use a pinned ArknightsGameData snapshot ({commit}). Stages are listed as game-data drop sources.
saveError: Could not save this plan in the browser.
stale: Latest inventory is unavailable; showing locally entered amounts.
